_comment: Who can actually execute each test case, and what access they need.
Three values, and the distinction is about EXECUTION AND VERIFICATION, not about which
End User    A tester with a recorder, a phone and a browser can run it AND decide
pass/fail unaided. No database, no logs, no shell.
Server Side Cannot be run or judged from the UI at all. Requires fault injection
(make the AI return 500), queue inspection, or direct API calls.
Both        The user performs the action, but the pass criteria cannot be confirmed
without a server check. These need two people, or one person with both
kinds of access — plan the run accordingly.
Consumed by build-test-workbook.py, gen-system-test.py and the test runner, so all
three agree. Change it here only.

access.Both: Recorder · phone · browser + Supabase read access

extra_access.SATE-REC-003: Serial console · bench power supply or drained cell
extra_access.SATE-REC-005: SD card able to be filled to capacity
extra_access.SATE-REC-006: Serial console · ability to cut power at a chosen moment
extra_access.SATE-QUE-006: Ability to force both the direct Wi-Fi and phone-bridged upload paths
extra_access.SATE-BE-002: AI fault injection — force a single 500
extra_access.SATE-BE-003: AI fault injection — force 5xx on every attempt
extra_access.SATE-BE-005: AI fault injection — force a timeout
extra_access.SATE-BE-006: AI fault injection — return malformed JSON
extra_access.SATE-BE-007: AI fault injection — return JSON missing required fields
extra_access.SATE-BE-008: Ability to replay a result callback
extra_access.SATE-BE-010: Ability to stop/start the Worker or edge function
extra_access.SATE-BE-011: Ability to fail the database write after a successful upload
extra_access.SATE-SEC-002: An HTTP client for direct PostgREST / device-api calls
extra_access.SATE-SEC-006: Ability to read a signed URL and wait out its expiry
extra_access.SATE-SEC-007: Log access · database access for audit and retention checks
extra_access.SATE-COMP-003: An older app build and an older firmware image

user_action._comment: For Server Side cases, what (if anything) the end user does — usually just supply a recording for the engineer to work with.
user_action.SATE-BE-001: Supply one normal recording; the rest is queue observation.
user_action.SATE-BE-010: Supply one normal recording, then confirm the app/web behaviour during the outage.
user_action.SATE-BE-012: Confirm the retry control appears and works in the UI after the engineer forces the failure.
user_action.SATE-SEC-007: None — audit, retention and log inspection only.
